verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a filing portal, but the evidence shows no documented way to submit, modify or act on many formalities at once. The dashboard overview (docs-5, docs-17) only tracks filings. The payment mode suited to high-volume filers (docs-12) is an adjacent billing feature, not bulk action. The keyless registry API (probe-2) is a separate state service that only reads company data, so it earns no credit here.
